body:
I'd love to see this merged. I'm working on JetBrains Rider's Godot support. There is a limitation in the Rider support for GDScript [RIDER-132535](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/RIDER-132535/GDExtension-Plugin-does-not-show-docs-or-highlight-in-gdscript), and its documentation part is gated on this PR landing.

The code itself is +10 lines wrapping an existing internal call. The thread has stalled on how thoroughly to document the return value, not on the API. @akien-mga already noted that shouldn't block the feature, and @KoBeWi proposed a pragmatic landing point in April: update the XML doc to say the method returns an empty Dictionary when the class isn't found, point readers at doc/class.xsd as the source-of-truth for the format, and add a caveat that the exact structure isn't guaranteed stable. That seems like a reasonable scope for this PR. I would be happy to help with those small doc tweaks, if needed (cc: @dsnopek)

My prototype fix https://github.com/JetBrains/godot-support/pull/591, I targetted the API from this PR. Merging this would unblocks the functionality in Rider.
